question: What is the chemical name of table salt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium chloride.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical name of table salt is **Sodium Chloride.**
 
• It has a chemical formula of **NaCl**, it is a two-atom molecule made of a single** Na atom** and a single **Cl atom.**
 
• The percent composition of sodium chloride is 39.34% Na and 60.66% Cl.
 
• The **molar mass **of Sodium chloride is **58.44 g/mol.**
 
• An aqueous solution of sodium chloride is called **Brine.**
